findings.statement: component domain
findings.reason: The claim assigns go.mod to ‘领域’. That file declares the whole aigw-cli module, Go toolchain and dependencies for CLI, terminal, credential, serialization and other packages; it is not part of the configuration domain represented by internal/domain/ or the catalog in manifests/.

findings.statement: relation program-entry-program-updates
findings.reason: The cited entry point does not perform ‘安装、更新’. Its only call to program is program.InstalledProgram(executable), which chooses the credential-reader role by checking whether the executable belongs to an installation; the remaining entry-point code initializes and executes the CLI.

findings.statement: relation commands-synchronization
findings.reason: The cited invocation files do not perform ‘收敛’. preview.go calls Synchronizer().Preview and PreviewProjection and passes their plans to presentation helpers; its own stated outcome is ‘Preview did not write configuration, credentials or client files’. These are read-only previews, not calls that converge or commit client configuration.

findings.statement: relation use-cases-synchronization
findings.reason: The cited files do not show the use cases performing ‘提交’. dependencies.go constructs a Synchronizer and uses it for Inspect; entrypoint.go asks it for a credential-reader plan and path; status.go obtains client IDs and inspects readiness. None calls Commit or CommitProjection. catalog.go reads provider model catalogs without changing configuration.

findings.statement: relation use-cases-diagnostics
findings.reason: The cited status.go uses diagnostics.Scope only as the type of ClientStatus.DiagnosticScope; its status inspection explicitly avoids endpoint authentication. The other cited files assemble dependencies, plan the credential reader, or query a model catalog directly. They do not call the target diagnostics component to ‘探测’.

overview.text: 内容取自 245 个文件，每个文件都标明 SHA-256。
overview.differs: Adds a count of 245 files and a SHA-256 for every file. The nearest model statements are scope, coverage and component files; they contain paths and directory prefixes, no per-file digests or stated file count. The guide's scope names the version and commit, not this digest inventory.

overview.text: 规划 · 应用 · 检查，一次受保护的事务
overview.differs: Places checking alongside planning and applying within one transaction. The nearest guide statement is step-synchronization: planning, configuration commit and client-file writes form the transaction. The guide describes aigw check separately in p-ready.

overview.text: 流量、重试和服务生命周期都归它们
overview.differs: Adds explicit ownership of retries and the service lifecycle to the endpoint products. The nearest guide statements are the request-execution row in p-owners and the compatible-endpoint fact, which assign request execution and external operation without enumerating retries.

overview.text: 首次设置：一个提供商、一个已安装的客户端和它的一个模型
overview.differs: Adds a one-provider, one-installed-client, one-model definition of setup. The nearest guide statements are rollout-connect and rollout-import; setup --from can apply a team file without any installed client or provider Token, so the overview omits that setup mode.

overview.text: 让每个已启用客户端的文件与配置一致；\-\-dry-run 只显示计划，不读取任何机密
overview.differs: Drops the guide's condition that an enabled client's model, authentication and files must be available, and adds a secret-free, plan-only dry-run claim. The nearest guide statement is rollout-check, which explicitly limits reconciliation to available prerequisites; the guide does not state the dry-run credential-read guarantee.

overview.text: 替换一个提供商的令牌
overview.differs: Adds the effect of provider rotate. The model commands component includes provider commands generically and the credentials component manages provider Tokens; neither it nor the guide states this command's replacement operation.

overview.text: 恢复配置和客户端文件，不恢复程序
overview.differs: Adds the complete restoration scope of config rollback and its explicit exclusion of the program. The nearest guide statement is ready-steps/step-session, which says config rollback prefers the verified snapshot; p-release separately describes self rollback.

overview.text: 写入之前就已完整，且不含机密
overview.differs: Adds completeness and absence of secrets as properties of the plan. The nearest guide statement is sync-steps/step-preflight, which states refusal and planning before changes but does not claim a complete secret-free plan; the model's adapter-seam lists Plan without those properties.

overview.text: 记下每个目标写入前后的确切状态
overview.differs: Places recording both exact before and after states in a preparation step before commit. The nearest guide step-restore states that each write first records its preimage, and race-steps/step-write records the exact bytes written after application; neither it nor the model states that exact observed postimages are already recorded for every target before commit.

overview.text: 凭一份回执补偿
